manage.isPublicHint: When on, anyone can view it at the address below without signing in.
manage.pickHint: Chosen photos are saved as public copies: resized, with GPS location and device data removed. Originals stay unchanged.
manage.areaHint: Neighborhood name only. Street numbers and unit numbers are not allowed.

consent.title: Client consent
consent.check: The client agreed to this project being shown publicly.
consent.withdrawConfirm: This unpublishes the project and deletes all public photos. Originals stay unchanged.
consent.private: Client name, unit number, prices and notes never appear on the public page.

manage.featuredHint: Shown in the slideshow at the top of the public page. A cover photo is required.
manage.durationHint: Leave blank to use the project dates.
manage.spaceLabelHint: If there are several bedrooms or bathrooms, name them like Bedroom A, Bedroom B.
manage.footerHint: Shown at the bottom of the public page. Empty fields are hidden.
manage.featuredLimitHint: How many projects appear in the photo slideshow at the top of the public page (1–6).
manage.featuredLimitOver: Only the first {limit} of {count} featured projects are shown. Reorder or unfeature some.
manage.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please select and copy it manually.
manage.emptyWorks: No projects yet. Use [Add project] to import a completed project.
manage.created: Project created. Record consent, then publish.
manage.addWorkHint: Import from a completed project. Saving does not publish it.
manage.title: Project name
manage.pickProjectFirst: Choose a project to see its photos.
manage.photosEmpty: This project has no photos to publish.
manage.copyFailedCount: {n} photos could not be added. You can add them again from the list.

edit.title: Edit project
edit.spacesHint: Spaces worked on in this home. Space tabs on the detail page come from each photo's space.
edit.photosHint: Changes save right away. Space sets the tab group and order (living → kitchen → bedroom…); a space name, if set, is shown on the tab instead (Bedroom A, Master).
edit.coverMissing: No cover photo. Choose one to publish.
edit.noPhotos: No photos yet. Add project photos below.
edit.beforeNotCover: A before photo cannot be the cover
edit.removeConfirm: It will be removed from the public page. Remove?
edit.noProject: This project has no source project, so photos cannot be added.
edit.allUsed: All photos from this project are already added.

footer.title: Footer
footer.hint: The bottom of the public page. Empty fields are hidden.
footer.sloganHint: Use / for a line break. If empty, the company name is shown.
footer.snsHint: Paste a link and we detect Instagram, YouTube, Naver Blog, Kakao Channel or website. Shown in this order.

snsError.invalid: This does not look like an account link.

footer.toneHint: Follows the page tone. Changing the tone changes the footer too.

layout.title: Project layout
layout.filterHint: Visitors can pick a space such as living room or kitchen. Hidden automatically when only one space exists.
layout.perHint: The next project peeks at the right edge. One at a time on phones.
layout.listHint: One wide photo at a time · name and size only
layout.filterShared: The space filter follows the desktop setting.
layout.mobileCarouselHint: Phones show one project at a time with the next one peeking in.

manage.businessLocked: The representative and business registration number were verified by the site administrator and can’t be changed here. If they changed, send your business registration certificate to support.

font.title: Fonts
font.systemHint: System sans uses the visitor’s device font: Malgun Gothic on Windows, Apple SD Gothic Neo on Mac and iPhone, Noto Sans on Android.
font.weightHint: Slide titles on photos stay at least Regular so they remain readable. With System sans, Regular may look Light or Bold depending on the device.

identity.title: Name · logo
identity.siteNameHint: The site name is set by the site administrator. Contact support to change it.
identity.logoUploaded: Logo updated. It shows on the public page right away.
identity.logoRemoved: Site logo removed. The company logo is shown instead.
identity.logoNone: No logo, so the first letter of the name is shown.
identity.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. A transparent PNG works best. Used on the site only; the company logo stays the same.
identity.logoHiddenNote: Only the site name shows at the top left, with no logo box. Press Save to apply it to the public page.

labels.title: Small labels
labels.hint: Leave blank to use the default. Small English labels are shown in capitals.

sample.notice: You have no projects yet, so sample tiles are shown. Real photos appear here once you add projects. Visitors never see these samples.
sample.slide: Your featured project photos will rotate here
sample.slideHint: Mark a project as featured to show it here
sample.title: Project name {n}

account.notLinked: This account is not linked to a home with this company yet. Log in with the account from your invitation email.

permission.requested: Access requested. You can use it once an owner or manager approves.
permission.noneBody: Only people chosen by the owner or managers can change the company homepage. Request the access you need.
permission.worksDesc: Add projects: add projects you manage and organize photos, spaces and before/after. Owners or managers publish.
permission.fullDesc: Full access: publish, featured projects, order and homepage settings (tone, intro, business info).
permission.worksBody: You can create draft projects from projects you manage. An owner or manager reviews and publishes them.
permission.worksNote: You have add-projects access. You can edit drafts of your own projects; publishing, featuring and order are done by owners or managers.

admin.title: Public site
admin.description: Settings on the company site that only site administrators control.
admin.none: This company has not set up its portfolio (public site) yet.
admin.siteNameHint: Shown as the main heading and at the top left. Leave blank to use the company name ({company}). The company cannot change this.
admin.siteNameCleared: Site name cleared. The company name is shown.
admin.unlocked: Not locked — the company can edit it
admin.lockConfirm: Lock the representative and business registration number?
admin.lockBody: Check them against the business registration certificate first. Once locked, the company cannot change these two fields.
admin.unlockBody: The company will be able to edit them again.
